plain: Something that spurs a person or an economy into action

webster.text: Literally, a goad; hence, something that rouses from languor; that which excites or increases action in the animal system, as a stimulus in medicine; or that which rouses the mind or spirits; as, the hope of gain is a powerful stimulus to labor and action.

example.quote: Will you take away every stimulus to industry, by declaring that he shall not retain the fruits of it ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 12, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
